title: Boarding School Juliet
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At Dahlia Academy, students from two rival nations live in opposing dorms, the Black Dogs and the White Cats. Romio Inuzuka, first-year leader of the Black Dogs, confesses to Juliet Persia, leader of the White Cats, and the two date in secret while hiding it from their feuding dorms. Kodansha USA publishes it in English; its age rating is not confirmed (to verify).
life_message: It holds up love that crosses group lines and the courage to change an unjust divided world.

content.note: Frequent dorm brawls, a kidnapping, beatings, drugging and a staged stabbing, mostly comedic (Wikipedia; AniList Gangs tag).
Kidnapping and attempted molestation arc raises stakes (Wikipedia).
Fan service gags: bath mix-up, Juliet half-dressed in Romio's bed, accidental grope, a porn magazine; MangaDex rates it suggestive (Wikipedia).
Insults between dorms; level not confirmed (to verify).
Hasuki's hurt over Romio's secret relationship (Wikipedia).
Lying to friends to keep the romance hidden; Char blackmails Romio (Wikipedia).

dominant: Progressivism (ending prejudice), Expressive individualism (secret love), Communitarianism (dorm loyalty)
